connect.title: Jokko ak LinkedIn
connect.intro: Duggal ci kontu LinkedIn bi yor say yëgle. Leadrat du lire sa kontu yëgle, Lead Gen Form prospect ak lim yëgle, ba noppi yónnee la coppite yi nga taal.
connect.need1: Rol ci kontu yëgle LinkedIn (Seetaankat wala lu gëna kawe).
connect.need2: Benn cër ci xëtu liggéeyukaay biñ lëkkale (Njiit, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Kuratër wala Jàngatkat) - LinkedIn daf koy sàkku mu séddoo ay njiit.
connect.need3: Laajte nimero telefon ci sa Lead Gen Forms - mënoo yokk lead bu amul nimero telefon.

connection.noPermission: Mën nga xool xët wii. Soo bëggee boole ak soppi jekkal yi fàww nga am ndigalu "Saytu jekkal yi".
connection.fetchTitle: Wutal prospect ci diggante bis yi
connection.fetchHint: Simili yu néew yu nekk dañuy saytu prospect yu bees yi, ba noppi ñu xoolaat 7 fan yu mujj yi bis bu nekk, suko defee dara du ñàkk. Jëfandikool lii ci prospect yi laata ngay jëflante, wala ngir xoolaat ab diir (ba 90 fan benn yoon). Leads yi fi nekk ci Leadrat dañu leen di sànni.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Wax leen LinkedIn ban ci njiit yi moo nekkoon prospect dëgg. Su benn prospect LinkedIn yeggee ci staas bi nga tànn ci suuf, Leadrat daf koy jottali LinkedIn , suko defee sa rapoor kampaañ di wane kalite prospect bi te LinkedIn mën na gis nit ñu bari ñu bëgg sa prospect yi gëna baax. ID lead LinkedIn bi ak hash bu benn yoon ci imeel bi kese lañuy yónnee.
capi.noRules: Ba leegi kenn xamul statut yi.
capi.created: Coppite yiñ defar ci LinkedIn ba noppi ñu def ci kàrt.
